scope: One hosted Nebius Nemotron Super alias diagnostic on all32 frozen development fixtures; no training, Qwen inference or reserved evaluation.
identity_condition: The hosted API exposes a model alias and no immutable weight revision. Even perfect agreement does not satisfy the original immutable-judge readiness condition. This run can report alias-scoped diagnostic scores only, not reproducible training-judge readiness, production reward validation or training approval.
case_labels_and_score_thresholds: Unchanged: all seven predeclared error maxima remain0. No fixture examples, labels or expected candidate scores are provided to the judge. Grade every case once in one batch.
retirement_rule: Any judge/prompt/reward change informed by these diagnostic outputs retires this check into design and requires fresh development validation. Never repair using reserved reader evaluation.
rejected_pre_dispatch_option: Ultra was not called: its1M provider context at1USD/M input cannot guarantee <=0.50 without tokenizer/template assumptions. The local upstream tokenizer audit did not attest hosted behavior. No Ultra inference cost was incurred.

budget_basis.explanation: Reserve the full advertised/enforced provider context as input and separately reserve all output, conservatively double-counting output if context is combined. This removes tokenizer/framing assumptions. Require unchanged active model/context/rates immediately before dispatch, n=1, fixed experiment-wide durable one-shot allowance and no retries. This is a reliable local request bound under the provider billing/context/output contract, not an account/invoice lock. If these conditions cannot be established, skip paid dispatch.

timeout_scope: 240-second per-I/O timeout plus soft elapsed-time check, not a hard absolute wall deadline; an interrupted request retains its consumed allowance and is never retried.
hypothesis: The fixed hosted alias can separate supported requested facts from the 32 clear predeclared evidence failures.
expected_signal: Complete score agreement with no unknown or missing cases; disagreements remain recorded.
decision_rule: Any predeclared score/unknown/missing error fails the diagnostic thresholds. No optimization follows even if all agree: immutable revision, one-case production behavior, independent human labels, broader reliability, rollout variance and training authorization remain absent.
